style_en: Vertical 9:16 miniature diorama 3D CG render in an empty white space. Smooth faceless figurines (no eyes, nose or mouth details). Soft shadows, slightly high angle. Mostly white and gray, only key objects red. 1800s European period details. Not gory, not scary: calm and clean. Keep the top 35% of the frame empty white space with no heads or objects; place the main subject between 35% and 68% of the height, centered.
avoid_en: skeletons, skulls, corpses, decay, blood, crosses with readable text, gravestones with readable names or numbers, readable text, logos, faces resembling real people
